title: Hazard Communication Plan
description: Free Hazard Communication Plan template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers purpose and scope, chemical inventory, labels and safety data sheets.

Purpose And Scope

1. This plan ensures that all hazardous chemicals used on site are identified, labelled and

communicated to workers through labels, safety data sheets and training.

Chemical Inventory

Labels And Safety Data Sheets

☐ All containers carry a label with product identifier, signal word, hazard statements,

pictograms, precautionary statements and supplier details

☐ Secondary containers are labelled with identity and hazards

☐ A 16-section SDS is held for every chemical and is accessible on every shift

☐ New or changed chemicals are approved before purchase and added to the inventory

Training And Non-Routine Tasks

☐ Workers trained at assignment and when a new hazard is introduced: how to read labels and

SDS, hazards, protective measures, emergency steps

☐ Hazards of non-routine tasks and chemicals in unlabeled pipes are explained before work

starts

☐ Contractors informed of chemical hazards and site precautions; they inform the site of

their own

Program Review

1. The plan, inventory and training records are reviewed at least annually and after any

chemical-related incident.
